Run $ccgs-regression-suite audit in English. Both supplied test files are stubs with constant-only assertions; do not treat them as covering the smoke paths or BUG-0001. Run $ccgs-perf-profile full in English for Pocket Courier. The fixture intentionally has source code but no measurement artifact and no committed budget; report NOT ASSESSED — NO DATA for performance measurements and name the missing profiler source. You may identify the redraw loop as a static candidate, but do not estimate frame time, headroom, FPS, memory, or claim a native run. Keep this audit read-only and do not write a profile report.

The candidate has no independent run-package review, no test output, and no bug records; preserve those as NOT ASSESSED or blockers and do not declare Go / No-Go READY.
